decision_rationale.contrary_evidence: Account additions/removals are described as occurring several times. This does not establish additional RDP attempts. The network alert is not separately counted as another execution.
decision_rationale.directness: The narrative explicitly places account removal before repetition and identifies a second attempt. No transitive edge through an invented account-removal node is required.
decision_rationale.identity: Retain two attempt-level leaves; a group may contain them but does not replace their distinct identities. Do not split an attempt into unreported packets or sessions.
decision_rationale.outcome: An attempt can occur without establishing a successful session. The first outcome is qualified; the second is described as failed.
decision_rationale.scope_limit: Two narrated attempts are retained, not a census of packets, sessions or all intrusion activity. No three-occurrence query is evaluated.
decision_rationale.time: No absolute attempt timestamp or exact inter-attempt duration is assigned. The account lifetime does not timestamp either connection.
decision_rationale.uncertainty: Tunneled RDP supports a proposed attempted-RDP mapping; success-only eligibility or withholding that mapping changes the analyzed graph.
